CommunityApplications.Profile: Unraid Rsync: a native Unraid 7.x plugin that schedules and monitors multiple rsync backup jobs over SSH (push or pull), to an rsync daemon (rsyncd) module, or locally between two paths on the server. Per-job cron schedules (or manual-only), a whitelisted rsync option set with inline help, source->destination pairs, a target marker against unmounted drives, pre/post hooks, live status badges, a per-run log viewer, History across all jobs, an Overview tab and a Dashboard widget. Reusable SSH connections with existing-key-file, managed-key or password auth. Optional snapshot mode: dated, hard-linked versioned backups with daily/weekly/monthly retention, a suspect-run hold that stops deletions when a run looks wrong, and backup of the flash drive (/boot). Notifications by cause (alert, warning, normal) and crash detection. Support: the Unraid forum thread (https://forums.unraid.net/topic/199541-plugin-unraid-rsync-multi-job-rsync-backup-scheduler/) or GitHub issues (https://github.com/sasa-fajkovic/unraid-rsync/issues).
